T: A marker is a promise. Dinner is a promise too.
D: John is forced to honour a blood oath and travels to Rome for a job he doesn't want.
P: Serve the wine when John visits the sommelier at the Rome Continental.
S: the Rome sommelier who presents his tasting like fine wine

A tasting flight of bites: chilli honey pecorino, prosciutto and melon with mint, and anchovy crostini with salsa verde, laid out like a tasting case. Cut 150g pecorino into shards. Warm 3 tbsp honey with a pinch of chilli flakes and drizzle over. Wrap 100g prosciutto around wedges of a quarter rockmelon and add mint leaves. Chop a handful of parsley with capers, lemon zest and 4 tbsp olive oil for salsa verde. Toast 8 baguette slices, spread with salsa verde and top each with an anchovy. Lay it all out in neat rows on a long board.
Roman street food before the job
Leftover risotto with tomato rolled around a cube of mozzarella, crumbed, fried at 180C until golden, so the cheese pulls like a phone cord.
Bowery King's chicken and mushroom pies
the rooftop kingdom of carrier pigeons, no pigeons harmed

Little puff pastry pies of chicken thigh and mushroom in a peppery thyme cream, baked golden and served in a wooden crate with hot English mustard. Fry 400g diced chicken thighs in 30g butter until browned, add 200g chopped mushrooms and thyme and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 1 tbsp flour, then 150ml cream and plenty of cracked pepper and simmer until thick, then cool. Cut 12 rounds from 2 sheets puff pastry and press into a muffin tin, fill, top with smaller rounds cut from a third sheet and brush with egg. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Serve with English mustard.
M: a simple bowl of pasta in Rome

Black pepper toasted in a dry pan, spaghetti cooked in a small amount of salted water, tossed off the heat with finely grated pecorino, the pepper and ladles of starchy pasta water until it turns creamy, never stringy.

Butterflied lamb leg marinated in rosemary, garlic, anchovy and lemon, charred on a screaming hot grill, sliced pink over crisp potatoes with salsa verde. Mash 4 anchovies, 4 garlic cloves, chopped rosemary, lemon zest and 4 tbsp olive oil and rub over a 1.5kg butterflied lamb leg. Marinate 2 hours. Parboil 1kg chunked potatoes for 8 minutes and roast in oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Grill the lamb on high heat, turning, to 56C inside, about 20 minutes, and rest 10 minutes. Chop parsley, capers, lemon juice and olive oil for salsa verde and spoon over the sliced lamb.
W: a Roman dessert before the job goes wrong
Savoiardi dipped quickly in espresso and coffee liqueur, layered with mascarpone whipped with yolks, sugar and cream, set overnight, cocoa sifted on top.
K: 30ml each of gin, red bitter aperitivo and sweet vermouth, stirred over ice for 20 seconds, strained over a big cube, orange peel twisted over.

s.note: the Rome sommelier who presents his tasting like fine wine
s.how: Cut 150g pecorino into shards. Warm 3 tbsp honey with a pinch of chilli flakes and drizzle over. Wrap 100g prosciutto around wedges of a quarter rockmelon and add mint leaves. Chop a handful of parsley with capers, lemon zest and 4 tbsp olive oil for salsa verde. Toast 8 baguette slices, spread with salsa verde and top each with an anchovy. Lay it all out in neat rows on a long board.

s.note: Roman street food before the job
s.how: Cook 250g arborio with a tin of crushed tomatoes and 600ml stock into a thick risotto, stir in 40g parmesan and cool. Roll around cubes of 150g mozzarella, crumb in egg and breadcrumbs and fry at 180C until golden.

m.note: a simple bowl of pasta in Rome
m.how: Toast 2 tsp cracked black pepper in a dry pan. Cook 500g spaghetti in a small amount of salted water. Off the heat, toss with 150g finely grated pecorino, the pepper and ladles of starchy pasta water until creamy, never stringy.

w.note: a Roman dessert before the job goes wrong
w.how: Brew 300ml strong coffee and add 60ml coffee liqueur. Whisk 3 yolks with 80g sugar, then fold in 500g mascarpone and 200ml whipped cream. Dip 24 savoiardi quickly and layer with the cream. Set overnight and sift cocoa on top.

d.how: For each drink, stir 30ml gin, 30ml red bitter aperitivo and 30ml sweet vermouth over ice for 20 seconds. Strain over a big cube and twist orange peel over the top. Makes four.
